mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points in a month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals a contraction in the industrial sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months (as reported in the latest quarterly data) indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.5%) signals a potential shift to tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a policy response to labor market deterioration, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor market shock
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
